question: Which option correctly states the elementary charge and its assignment to common particles?

options.A: $|e| = 1.6 \times 10^{-19}$ C; proton carries $+e$ and electron carries $-e$.
options.B: $|e| = 1.6 \times 10^{-19}$ A; proton carries $-e$ and electron carries $+e$.
options.C: $|e| = 1.6 \times 10^{19}$ C; proton carries $-e$ and electron carries $+e$.
options.D: $|e| = 9.11 \times 10^{-31}$ C; both proton and electron carry $+e$.
